ImageDescription.value:
The strapwork title-page border incorporating Gessner's device is signed CS for Christoph Schweitzer. There is a smaller version of the device on V5v. Portrait heads of the emperors appear in large roundels (28 cm.) on the recto of each leaf starting with A1, and brief biographies appear within decorative borders on the versos. The architectural borders of the portraits are signed RW for Rudolf Wyssenbach, and HRMD for Hans Rudolf Manuel Deutsch. The arabesque tailpieces that follow some of the biographies are from Peter Flötner's designs published at Zurich in 1549. For identification of the graphic artists, see Mortimer
Signatures: α⁶ A-V⁶
Mortimer, R. French 16th-cent.
Binding: pigskin. Four central panels (arranged 2 over 2) and an outer border are blind-stamped with rolls and outlined with triple fillets. One of the three rolls contains half-length figures (David, John the Baptist, Paul and another, probably an evangelist). Title written at head of spine. Two pairs of ties at foredge, and one each at head and at foot
At upper left-hand corner of front pastedown is Theodore Besterman's calligraphic label, signed P.S. On the facing flyleaf is a label with the printed legend "Historici. XIX." followed by "a-20" in MS. Above this label is written the number 1131
